_about: Public-domain Leonard of Port Maurice (1676-1751), the Franciscan preacher of the Stations of the Cross, for the Word Hoard: The Hidden Treasure, on the Holy Mass (Edinburgh, 1855; Dublin, 1861) and the Counsels to Confessors (Dublin, 1875), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
